name: Culvert crossing (the road halt below the hills)
region: Lordaeron, south of the Thalassian Pass, on the road toward Millhaven; first Lordaeron hedges

sensoryProfile.sight: Hawthorn and bramble hedges thick along both sides, haws dark red, blackberries over; road mud at the edges, packed earth down the middle, rutted deep with old straw trodden in; a stream comes out of a low wet wood and runs under the road through a stone culvert; dawn sky the colour of dishwater
sensoryProfile.sound: Stream water; rangers' breathing; Windrunner's voice calling 'Mage' three times from far off
sensoryProfile.touch: Cold through robe at once; grit, a small stone in the heel of the hand, a dried ridge of rut; clay cold and heavy beneath; frost fern on the road
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: Outwardly ordinary hedge-country; beneath it the contamination has soaked into clay, water and roots

establishedFacts.fact: Windrunner halts here ('Here. Water them.') after Jaina's request on the hill was refused.

Jaina knelt on the crown of the road between the ruts, right palm flat, and went down: road crust, clay holding moving water, hedge roots and hawthorn wood, stone, and the broad old leyline far beneath. The contamination had left the lines and was in all of it, a little in a worm or root-tip 'like a little salt'.
A white frost fern a hand's width spread into the ruts around Jaina's palm and went grey at the edges when she lifted it; her skin stuck and peeled.
The rangers ringed Jaina during the read: Lyriel facing north (up the road), Neral facing south, Cyndia at the gap in the hedge facing the wood, the fourth ranger in the stream holding the horses.
The water here tastes (when Jaina drinks from Cyndia's skin) of the post's cistern: cold and stony.

eventsHere.event: Jaina's first deep read of the ground: contamination has left the lines and is in the clay, water, roots. She is called three times to come back.
